$comment: Entry schema for contributes.databaseDrivers (API v2 process plugins that declare the database.driver capability). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_database_drivers.go (install) and database_drivers_proxy.go (connect); the wire protocol is docs/architecture/database-driver-protocol.md. Credentials (the password and token connection fields) cross to the plugin only as plugin.db.connect params, only for connections the user explicitly bound to this plugin driver (a host-stored credential-release grant, required in every approval mode, never exported or synced). Options never hold secrets. A driver is never a silent fallback for a built-in type or another plugin.
description: Database drivers: connection types implemented by this plugin process over the plugin.db.* protocol, offered in the connection dialog.

id.description: Driver id; the same id must be listed in the initialize databaseDrivers.drivers negotiation.

descriptionLocalized.description: Translated description per locale (for example zh).

icon.description: Relative path of an SVG or PNG under assets/ or icons/ (sanitized by the host).

sqlDialect.description: Editor dialect for completion and formatting; defaults to generic.

replaces.description: Built-in type this driver can take over after the user explicitly rebinds a connection; at most one driver per plugin replaces a type.

fields.description: Connection dialog fields. password and token are secret: stored encrypted by the host and sent only in plugin.db.connect.

required.description: Subset of fields the user must fill in.

fileExtensions.description: File picker filter; requires the filePath field.

default.description: Must match type, bounds and enum.

enumLabelsLocalized.description: Display labels of the enum values per locale: one label per enum value, in enum order. Requires enum.

additionalProperties.description: Non-secret driver option. secret, pattern and format are rejected: credentials belong in the password or token field.

features.description: Optional capabilities. rows.* needs metadata.columns and metadata.primaryKeys; destructive.* needs metadata.tables (destructive.dropDatabase / destructive.clearDatabase act on a whole database or schema). transaction.snapshotWrite runs host-built snapshot/write/read-back steps in one transaction (plugin.db.snapshotWrite). Adding a rows.*, destructive.* or transaction.snapshotWrite feature or a new driver re-requests the user's permission.
